dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem: Polynomial-time maximum independent set on $P_t$-free graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine whether maximum independent set is decidable in polynomial time for $P_t$-free graphs for $t \geq 7$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Subexponential-time algorithms for maximum independent set on $P_t$-free graphs were given by Brause and independently by Bascó, Marx and Tuza; the present paper extends the subexponential approach to a broader class of problems including maximum independent set, but polynomial-time decidability for $t \geq 7$ remains open.
